description.en:
Places a tornado reserved with CMND_BTL_REG_TORNADE on the pitch and switches it on.

The tornado's entry in the pitch-object table receives the position (X and Z, height 0) and its active field is set to 1, which is what CMND_BTL_IS_ACTIVE_TORNADE reads back.
The optional fourth argument is stored in the entry as the tornado's strength. A value of 300 or more also turns the tornado into the stronger variant (its active field becomes 3 instead of 1). The optional fifth argument is stored in the next field of the entry; its effect was not identified.
Tornado strength. 300 or more makes it the stronger variant.
Stored with the tornado; its effect was not identified. The shipped scripts pass 0 or 1.

true once the tornado is placed.
null if the match system is not ready or fewer than 3 arguments were given.

examples.case: Switching the tornado on for a scripted beat, then moving it (real usage, from btl0008.nut)
Placing a tornado with default settings
